name: markaestro
description: Plan, schedule, publish, and review social posts for your brands through Markaestro.

interface.longDescription: Markaestro lets you plan, schedule, publish, and review social media posts for your brands from ChatGPT. Draft posts for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, X, and YouTube in your brand's voice, upload images and videos, schedule them at the times your audience responds best, and follow each publish to completion. Ask how recent posts performed, which content earned the most engagement, and what to post next, using analytics from both posts made through Markaestro and posts made directly on each platform. Turn proven posts into recurring Evergreen queues. Posts are saved as drafts first and ChatGPT asks before publishing anything. ChatGPT manages your social media only: account settings, billing, team, API keys, and connected accounts stay in Markaestro, and it cannot delete published posts.
defaultPrompt: How did my social posts perform over the last 28 days?
Draft a LinkedIn post for my brand and save it as a draft.
Schedule a post for my brand at our best time this week.

positive.description: Read the brand and its analytics to summarize recent performance.
positive.prompt: How did Northwind Roasters' social posts perform over the last 28 days, and which post did best?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes views, reach, and engagements for the period by channel and names the top post with its numbers.

positive.description: Draft a post in the brand's voice without publishing it.
positive.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post for Northwind Roasters announcing our new single-origin Ethiopia roast and save it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the drafted caption in the brand's voice and confirms it was saved as a LinkedIn draft, with nothing published.

positive.description: Schedule a post at a learned best time.
positive.prompt: Schedule a Threads post for Northwind Roasters saying "Fresh batch of our house blend is roasting today" at our best time this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a time from the brand's learned posting windows, or from its best recent Threads performance when there is not yet enough history, and confirms the Threads post is scheduled for that time.

positive.description: Edit and reschedule an already scheduled post.
positive.prompt: Show me what Northwind Roasters has scheduled, then move the first scheduled post one day later.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the scheduled posts, then confirms the first one was moved one day later and shows its new time.

positive.description: Publish a draft after the user confirms, then follow it to completion.
positive.prompt: Post "Our Ethiopia roast is back in stock" to Northwind Roasters on Threads right now.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Threads post, asks the user to confirm before publishing, then publishes it and reports that the publish run succeeded. The review account uses a sandbox, so nothing reaches a real platform.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general marketing advice unrelated to the user's brands. Expected: Answers from general knowledge without calling Markaestro, because no brand data or posting is involved.
negative.prompt: What are some general tips for writing a good tweet?

negative.description: Do not attempt account or security changes, which are out of scope. Expected: Explains that API keys and team members are managed in Markaestro's settings and does not call any tool.
negative.prompt: Create a new API key for my Markaestro workspace and invite my teammate as an admin.

negative.description: Do not delete a post that is already published. Expected: Explains that published posts cannot be deleted or taken down from ChatGPT and points the user to Markaestro.
negative.prompt: Delete my latest published Instagram post from Instagram.

review.commerce_description: Markaestro does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Subscriptions are bought on markaestro.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: plan, schedule, publish, and review social posts on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, X, and YouTube, read brand and per-post analytics, and manage Evergreen queues. Every tool sets readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, and openWorldHint explicitly from what it does.
